conditions: Normal destruction of a fully initialized struct. Any user-defined Drop::drop call returns normally.
limitations: Partial initialization, partial moves, explicit suppression of destruction and unwinding behavior require their own conditions.
The field rule concerns the order of declared struct fields.

triggers: Material correction of the referenced rule, applicability, or edition scope.

statement: When a fully initialized Rust struct is dropped, its Drop::drop method, if implemented, runs before its fields are recursively dropped in declaration order.
